note: S11.4 (R-lift) — the in-harness depth-0 byte-identity proof for arrangement_targets_rec. The harness builds the bridge from this tree via bridge_arrangement (the same flat path the 5 existing arrangement_targets fixtures use) and asserts arrangement_targets_rec(bridge; topo) == arrangement_targets(bridge; topo) byte-equal. On a flat bridge every binding entry has empty .nested.segments, so _emit_at never recurses; the leaf arm reads contents[0] (or the bare entry minus the contents/nested wrappers) + merges off_top — character-identical to arrangement_targets. REUSES the context_switch scene (presented 201/202 from cells + off-top 200 from the bridge off_top), exercising both the presented and off-top emit paths. The authoritative all-corpus proof remains parcel/arrangement-bridge.sh on the NON-rec path (which adding _rec cannot redden); this pins the _rec depth-0 byte-identity in the standard harness. The harness emits {eq:bool}.
